name: Ring of the Treacherous Advisor
body:
Price 40,000 gp; Slot ring; CL 7th; Weight — lbs.; Aura moderate illusion and transmutation

DESCRIPTION

A finely wrought snake is entwined around this platinum ring. When the wearer of a ring of the treacherous advisor is targeted with a spell that would reveal alignment, the wearer’s alignment appears to match that of the caster of the revealing spell. By speaking a command word, the tiny snake on the ring opens its mouth and allows the wearer to lie freely, even under the effects of spells such as discern lies or zone of truth, for no longer than 1 hour per day. Once the hour of time is up, or if the ring is deactivated, the snake’s mouth closes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 20,000 gp; Feats Forge Ring, aura alteration, glibness
